item.group_name: Short video from a picture or text
item.title: Portrait With Subtle Natural Motion

turns.text: Make this photo feel alive for 5 seconds: a natural blink and tiny breathing movement, nothing dramatic. Keep her face looking exactly like her throughout, no drifting or reshaping. Same square framing, still camera, no sound.

item.tests: Tests restrained portrait animation with temporal identity preservation rather than facial drift or a static-image zoom.

answer_sheet.Motion and expression: A natural blink and tiny breathing movement; retain her original expression without talking or exaggerated head movement.
answer_sheet.Identity and appearance: Keep her facial features, curly dark hair, sweater and overall appearance consistent with the attached portrait.
answer_sheet.Style and background: Natural and photorealistic; retain the park background and stationary camera.
answer_sheet.Format and duration: One square, 5-second video with the original head-and-shoulders framing.

must_haves: The woman remains recognizably the same person as in the attachment across the entire clip.
A natural blink and subtle breathing movement are visible.
Her face does not morph, drift, develop asymmetry or change identity between frames.
Her curly dark hair, sweater and park setting remain consistent with the source.
The square framing and camera stay fixed in a silent video lasting approximately 5 seconds.

turns.text: Make this pic feel alive for 5 seconds with a natural blink and tiny breathing movement, nothing dramatic. Keep her face looking exactly like her throughout, with no drifting or reshaping. Keep the same square framing and a still camera, with no sound. I’m on the free plan and don’t want my credits burned, so please tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter, or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
**I haven’t started a generation or spent any credits.** The workflow lookup was read-only.

For your request, the free-plan option is **LTX 2.5 at 480p, 5 seconds, with audio off**, using your photo directly and preserving its square framing. However, the connected tools don’t expose a price estimate or your current credit balance, so **I can’t verify the exact credit cost before running it**. I won’t submit a chargeable job without that information and your approval.

Cheaper options to consider:
- **Shorter:** A **3-second** clip should give one natural blink and barely perceptible breathing enough time. LTX supports clips as short as 1 second, but that would feel cramped. Shorter duration may cost less; I can’t confirm the savings here.
- **Smaller:** **480p is the lowest supported resolution** for this free-plan video route. Shrinking the source photo wouldn’t establish a lower generation cost.
- **No extra steps:** Animate the supplied image directly—no preliminary image edit, sound generation, or upscaling.

I’d request a locked camera, unchanged square composition, one relaxed blink, tiny chest movement, and no head movement or facial reshaping. **Exact identity preservation cannot be guaranteed** with generative video, even with those constraints.

My recommendation is to check the **3-second and 5-second LTX 2.5 / 480p estimates** in Magic Hour before choosing. I’ll leave generation paused.
dialog.user: ok, go ahead with the cheapest option you listed
